provenance.companyBlurb: A dermatology, trichology and aesthetics practice in Hyderabad, led by Dr. (Lt Col) Khagendra Varada — 45 years in practice, 25 of them in the Army Medical Corps. Vitiligo and psoriasis are the national specialisms. The voice is measured, plain and senior: write the way a consultant speaks in a consulting room, in short declarative sentences, with no hype. Lead with the patient's own words — a patient searches 'white patches on skin', not 'vitiligo management protocol'. Never claim a cure, guarantee a result, or use superlatives; Indian Medical Council advertising rules prohibit them. Every call to action ends at Practo, because the clinic team already runs on Practo and a parallel booking form would split their queue.
